captions: Table 83 Main specifications for the reference technologies for heating
reason: This report compiles full life-cycle inventories only for the Power-to-X chains (hydrogen, synthetic natural gas, methanol); a ground-source heat pump appears in it solely as a reference heating technology. The only place it is quantified is Tab. 83 'Main specifications for the reference technologies for heating' (p.131), which carries the conversion efficiency the dataset's own comment repeats (390 % LHV) and therefore the electricity draw per MJ of heat. There is no 'Life-cycle inventories ...' table for a heat pump anywhere in the report, so this range is a specification table rather than a true unit-process inventory and nothing beyond the electricity input can be read from it.
